reason: no_reward: Balancer V1 is a user-pays AMM with no keeper/reward function. Verified BPool.sol shows the only permissionless state fn is gulp(address token) which just syncs a bound token's cached balance and pays the caller 0; all admin fns require msg.sender == _controller (pool creator, not a keeper role); swaps/joins/exits are user trades whose fee goes to LPs. 7-day sampling of pools found almost no activity at all. BFactory itself: newBPool costs BAL, collect/setBLabs admin; no reward fn.
